 Marco Rose hints at Bournemouth rotation before Leeds as Kroupi steps up after injury 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article According to yorkshireeveningpost.co.uk, Bournemouth manager Marco Rose plans to rotate for tonight’s Carabao Cup tie against Aston Villa before hosting Leeds United in the Premier League on Saturday.
 The Cherries face Villa on the south coast in the fourth round, with a quick turnaround into the weekend at the Vitality Stadium. Daniel Farke’s side, by contrast, will contest only their fourth match of the month and have not played midweek since their Carabao Cup defeat to Chelsea on September 9.
 OneFootball Videos
 Rose said he wants to compete in every competition and will still field a competitive line-up, while managing workloads to keep players fit. He stressed that rotation is earned on merit and warned that losing two or three players would remove the option to refresh.
 By Saturday, Bournemouth will have played six October fixtures compared with Leeds’ three.
 One player still being eased back is Eli Junior Kroupi , who had surgery on a fractured metatarsal in July and made his return off the bench in last weekend’s 3-0 win at Manchester United. The 20-year-old scored home and away against Leeds last season, including a 93rd-minute equaliser in a 2-2 draw at Elland Road in September.
 Rose added that Kroupi needs further training to tolerate the load and that the plan is to build his minutes, with staff and supporters pleased to see him back. He could be available for a decent spell on Saturday if training goes well.
 Source: yorkshireeveningpost.co.uk
